columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Recoverable digital work needs causally aligned agent and environment checkpoints
columns.title_zh: 可恢复数字工作需要因果对齐的 Agent 与 Environment Checkpoint
columns.source_zh: AgentRewind 一手研究论文 arXiv 2608.14380
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260903-009 after Skill 02 triage. AgentRewind studies the failure created when reasoning state and external environment state are rolled back independently, then proposes aligned context-environment checkpoints for long-horizon recovery. The bounded Digital Employee question is which causal identity, committed-effect boundary and prior-attempt evidence must travel with a checkpoint pair so resumed work remains accountable rather than merely executable. This is a question-first primary research object with explicit failure, mechanism and evaluated finding evidence.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260903-009。AgentRewind 研究 Reasoning State 与外部 Environment State 被分别回滚时产生的失配，并提出面向 Long-horizon Recovery 的 Context–Environment 对齐 Checkpoint。边界清晰的数字员工问题是：一对 Checkpoint 必须携带哪些因果身份、已提交 Effect Boundary 与 Prior-attempt Evidence，才能让恢复后的工作不仅可执行，而且仍可问责。该对象由问题驱动，并同时具有明确的 Failure、Mechanism 与评估型 Finding 证据。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the checkpoint construction, alignment and rewind protocol, experimental tasks and baselines, recovery and progress metrics, effect-duplication assumptions, ablations, and the boundary between demonstrated long-horizon coding behavior and general digital work.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Checkpoint 构造、对齐与 Rewind Protocol，实验任务与 Baseline，Recovery 与 Progress 指标，Effect Duplication 假设、Ablation，以及从已展示的 Long-horizon Coding Behavior 推广到一般数字工作的边界。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Delegated agent authority must remain a narrowing principal chain and constrain action composition
columns.title_zh: Agent 委派权限必须保持为收窄的 Principal Chain，并约束 Action Composition
columns.source_zh: Bounded Agents 一手研究论文 arXiv 2608.15888
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260903-010 after Skill 02 triage. Bounded Agents treats delegation as a principal chain whose cumulative scope, budget and prohibited compositions are evaluated outside the model, and reports security gains with measurable utility tradeoffs under a compromised-model setting. The bounded architecture question is how an enterprise multi-agent runtime can make delegated authority transitive but non-expansive while refusing sequences of individually allowed calls that compose into a prohibited outcome. The object is the cross-action governance mechanism and evaluated finding, not a vendor release.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260903-010。Bounded Agents 将委派建模为 Principal Chain，并在模型外部检查累计 Scope、Budget 与禁止的 Action Composition；论文在 Compromised-model Setting 下报告了安全收益及可测量的 Utility Tradeoff。边界清晰的架构问题是：企业 Multi-agent Runtime 如何让委派权限可传递但不可扩张，同时拒绝由多个单独允许调用组合出的禁止结果。研究对象是跨 Action 的治理机制与评估发现，而不是厂商 Release。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the principal-chain model, scope and budget semantics, composition checker, threat model, attack and utility measurements, policy placement outside the model, and limits on applying the reported results to heterogeneous enterprise agents and protocols.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Principal-chain Model、Scope 与 Budget 语义、Composition Checker、Threat Model、Attack 与 Utility 测量、模型外 Policy Placement，以及将结果推广到异构企业 Agent 与协议时的边界。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: OAuth discovery must preserve authorization-server identity through issuer binding
columns.title_zh: OAuth Discovery 必须通过 Issuer Binding 保持 Authorization-server Identity
columns.source_zh: MCP Python SDK 与独立 MCP Client 在同一时间窗内的实现级比较证据
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260903-007 after Skill 02 triage. Independent MCP clients converged on validating authorization-server metadata against an expected issuer during OAuth discovery. The bounded engineering question is which identity must remain invariant across protected-resource metadata, redirects and authorization-server discovery so a syntactically valid endpoint cannot substitute a different credential authority. This passes the evidence-sufficiency and release-boundary gates because it is a comparative implementation mechanism with a concrete confused-authority failure, not a changelog item.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260903-007。独立 MCP Client 在同一时间窗内收敛到：OAuth Discovery 时必须把 Authorization-server Metadata 与 Expected Issuer 进行核验。边界清晰的工程问题是：跨 Protected-resource Metadata、Redirect 与 Authorization-server Discovery，哪一个 Identity 必须保持不变，才能防止语法有效的 Endpoint 替换真正的 Credential Authority。该对象是带有具体 Confused-authority Failure 的比较型实现机制，不是 Changelog 条目，因此通过 Evidence Sufficiency 与 Release Boundary。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the relevant commits and tests across independent clients, trace the discovery and redirect paths, identify the exact issuer comparison and error behavior, distinguish OAuth and MCP requirements, and record what the implementation evidence does not prove about end-to-end credential security.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验独立 Client 的相关 Commit 与 Test，追踪 Discovery 与 Redirect Path，识别精确的 Issuer Comparison 与 Error Behavior，区分 OAuth 与 MCP 要求，并记录实现证据不能证明哪些端到端 Credential Security 结论。
